title: Inverse image of modules is left adjoint to direct image (etale sites)
statement: Let $u:U\to V$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], $\mathcal O$ a sheaf of commutative rings on $V_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], and $u^{-1}$, $u_*$ the inverse and direct images on sheaves of sets, abelian groups and rings, with unit $\eta:\mathrm{id}\to u_*u^{-1}$, of [lem-weil-pbc-etale-inverse-image-algebraic-structures]. For a sheaf of $\mathcal O$-modules $\mathcal G$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] let $u^{-1}\mathcal G$ be the sheaf of $u^{-1}\mathcal O$-modules with action $u^{-1}(\mu_{\mathcal G}):u^{-1}\mathcal O\times u^{-1}\mathcal G=u^{-1}(\mathcal O\times\mathcal G)\to u^{-1}\mathcal G$; for a sheaf of $u^{-1}\mathcal O$-modules $\mathcal F$ on $U_{\Et}$ let $u_*\mathcal F$ be the sheaf of $\mathcal O$-modules with action $\mathcal O\times u_*\mathcal F\xrightarrow{\eta\times\mathrm{id}}u_*u^{-1}\mathcal O\times u_*\mathcal F=u_*(u^{-1}\mathcal O\times\mathcal F)\xrightarrow{u_*\mu_{\mathcal F}}u_*\mathcal F$. Then a morphism of abelian sheaves $\alpha:u^{-1}\mathcal G\to\mathcal F$ is $u^{-1}\mathcal O$-linear if and only if its adjoint $\beta:\mathcal G\to u_*\mathcal F$ under the adjunction $u^{-1}\dashv u_*$ on abelian sheaves is $\mathcal O$-linear; hence the adjunction bijection restricts to a bijection $\operatorname{Hom}_{u^{-1}\mathcal O}(u^{-1}\mathcal G,\mathcal F)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O}(\mathcal G,u_*\mathcal F)$, natural in $\mathcal G$ and $\mathcal F$, and the unit $\mathcal G\to u_*u^{-1}\mathcal G$ and counit $u^{-1}u_*\mathcal F\to\mathcal F$ of the abelian adjunction are linear.

proof.text: Use [lem-weil-pbc-etale-inverse-image-algebraic-structures] to choose ea, da, Lr, ar, er, dr. The section equations for da and dr imply their components are identity maps, by extensionality on sections. Simplify the two hom-equivalence compatibility equations by these identities to obtain ha and hr.

Apply [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-module-construction] to these chosen lifts and hr,ha to obtain LM, its underlying abelian comparison e and the actual transported-action equation. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-module-linear-criterion] to obtain the equivalence of the two existential linear lift conditions.

For each module morphism h choose the module lift of the abelian adjunct of e inverse followed by the underlying h. Faithfulness of the two forgetful functors and injectivity of the abelian hom equivalence prove this assignment injective. For a module map k into direct image apply the converse linear lift criterion to the inverse abelian adjunct of its underlying map; this supplies an h mapping to k, proving surjectivity. Build E with Equiv.ofBijective. Naturality on the left follows from naturality of e inverse and the abelian hom equivalence; naturality on the right follows from that hom equivalence and the sectionwise definition of direct image. Adjunction.mkOfHomEquiv gives am, and its hom-equivalence formula follows from mkOfHomEquiv_homEquiv. These calculations are the fully proved private helper adjunctionOfLinearLifts, with the right-hand forgetful comparison d = Iso.refl.

Evaluate the compatible hom equivalence at the identity of LM(G). Adjunction.homEquiv_id and homEquiv_unit give the unit formula. For the counit, its module adjunct is the identity by homEquiv_symm_id and apply_symm_apply. Apply the inverse abelian hom equivalence to the compatibility equation, use homEquiv_counit, and cancel e inverse with e. This gives the counit formula. Combine the chosen witnesses and all seven clauses, without changing any statement.

No new nodes: the module-object reformulation of sheaves of modules is read off from def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category and lem-weil-pbc-sheaf-algebraic-structures-objects (products sectionwise). Mathlib: SheafOfModules.pullback is an abstract left adjoint of pushforward along phi = eta_O; its identification with u^{-1}G is this node, so partial only.
